title: Stock Market Rotations
summary: Japan’s financial options and a software entry.
assessment: The four named software additions show positive interim results. Japan’s external balance sheet is a useful starting point, but pension governance and the allocation chronology materially qualify the intervention story. Gold and Bitcoin views remain open over their longer horizons.

claims.claim: Depleted inventories reduce the energy buffer.
claims.reason: For a fixed minimum operating stock and unchanged supply/demand, a lower inventory leaves less available drawdown capacity. This supports vulnerability, but the amount of future shortage also depends on rerouting, production and demand response.

claims.claim: Inflation is cooling without monetary acceleration.
claims.reason: The CPI decline from May to June is confirmed, but the stronger rule that inflation necessarily fizzles without rapid money growth is too categorical. Velocity, real output, supply shocks, expectations and the money aggregate chosen matter; a one-month decline does not identify the mechanism.

claims.claim: GPIF assets are available for currency defense.
claims.reason: The pension portfolio is large, but combining it with official reserves overstates immediately deployable government intervention capacity. GPIF has a beneficiary mandate and limits on unrelated policy objectives. Allocation changes are possible within governance constraints; they are not a freely available currency-defense account.

coverage_note: Full numbered text and image inventory read. All material theses across macro, digital assets, investment analysis and concluding sections considered. Position listings and incidental descriptive statistics are excluded unless they support a thesis.
framework_lessons: Asset ownership and legal mandate matter as much as aggregate balance-sheet size.
A favorable entry outcome does not prove a permanent industry moat.
verification_limitations: Current page snapshot is not an authenticated publication-date version.
A missing horizon is not replaced with an invented author deadline.
Market sensitivities use vendor adjusted closes and do not reconstruct portfolio execution.
